state.question: For Mallow Life, what do the latest records show about hedged foreign bond carry? Please resolve this specific point: The September currency-hedged carry on its dollar sovereign portfolio, including the hedge cost rather than the unhedged coupon.
state.conclusion: Mallow Life increased its foreign sovereign bond allocation in the quarter.
state.gap: The September currency-hedged carry on its dollar sovereign portfolio, including the hedge cost rather than the unhedged coupon.

candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Mallow Life, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of the September currency-hedged carry on its dollar sovereign portfolio, including the hedge cost rather than the unhedged coupon.
